description: Search GitHunt's pre-indexed pool of GitHub developers by location, role, and skills. Returns candidates ranked by fit with scores, activity, and contact info. Fast (pool-served, no live crawl); page with offset.

isHireable.description: Only candidates whose GitHub profile sets the 'hireable' flag.

location.description: City or country to search, freeform, e.g. 'Warsaw', 'San Francisco', 'Poland'. Common abbreviations and native names are normalized (SF, NYC, UK, Warszawa).

maxResults.description: Candidates to return per call (1-100, default 25).

minExperienceYears.description: Minimum years since the GitHub account was created.

offset.description: Top-ranked candidates to skip, for paging (0-200, default 0). Use with maxResults to fetch the next page. Each search scores at most ~200 candidates, so pages past that are empty.

role.description: Role to rank candidates for. One of: fullstack, frontend, backend, mobile, devops, ai-engineer, ai-orchestrator, ml-engineer, data-scientist, data-engineer, security, cloud, blockchain, embedded, gamedev, ios-developer, android-developer, sre, platform-engineer, qa-engineer, solutions-architect, cto, vp-engineering, head-engineering, engineering-manager, tech-lead, product-manager, director-engineering.

skills.description: Technologies or keywords to match, e.g. ['react', 'typescript']. Synonyms are handled (k8s -> kubernetes).

strictSkills.description: If true, exclude candidates that match none of the given skills.

name: search_developers

locationSuggestions.description: Similar supported locations, present when the location matched nothing.

title: Search developers
